channel.title: InternDoor Blog
channel.description: Original data and practical guides on engineering internships and entry-level jobs in India, from the postings InternDoor tracks every day.

item.title: Before you apply: seven checks for an engineering internship posting
item.description: Most postings are what they say they are. These checks take a few minutes and catch the ones that are not: fees, missing pay, mislabelled experience and terms left for the last paragraph.

item.title: Engineering internships in India, September 2026: what 425 postings show
item.description: Most employers posted once or twice, four in ten roles were in Bengaluru, and only 18 postings said what they paid. Here is what the month looked like, and what it means if you are applying.

item.title: Intern, trainee, apprentice or entry level: what the job title tells you
item.description: Job titles are written by recruiters, not by any rulebook. We counted the words in the titles of 2,579 engineering postings in India, and the title rarely settles what you need to know. Here is what each word usually signals, and what to read instead.

item.title: Only 4% of engineering internship postings in India say what they pay
item.description: Postings tell you where you will sit far more often than what you will be paid. We read every September posting that named a figure and list them here, with what to ask when a posting says nothing.

item.title: The skills Indian engineering internship postings ask for, and what to learn first
item.description: We counted the skills named in 575 engineering internship postings in India. Software roles share a short, stable list; hardware roles want something else. Here is the list, and how to use it without chasing every line of it.
